com.vector.cfg.model.derived

Interface IDerivedElementInfo


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IDerivedElementInfo
    IDerivedElementInfo provides information about derived containers or removed derived sub containers. This wrapper is valid for instances of type MIHasContainer.
    The IDerivedElementInfo can be used to retrieve information about element or delete it:
    • getRemovedDerivedSubContainers(): Retrieves the removed children, which could be used to restore them the children
    • isDerived(): returns true if the element is derived
    • delete(): deletes the element regardless if it is derived or not

    • Method Detail

      • delete

        @PublishedMethod
void delete()
        The method delete() deletes the MIContainer regardless, if it is derived or not. This method behaves as follows:
        • If the container is a derived container it calls the derived container deletion operation to delete it.
        • All other containers with be deleted by means of moRemove()

      • getRemovedDerivedSubContainers

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<IRemovedDerivedContainerInfo> getRemovedDerivedSubContainers()

      • isDerived

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isDerived()
        Returns true, if the element is derived. So if the CE has a initial value (the object is derived) but is still deletable.
        Returns:
        true, if is derived

      • isRemovedSubContainer

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isRemovedSubContainer(java.lang.String containerName)
        Returns true if this element contains a removed derived container with the specified name.

        The behavior in variant projects depends on the variant context which is active when this method is being called:

        • In a single variant view, this method reports the state for this variant and doesn't take other variants into account
        • In the unfiltered view, this method returns true when at least one variant contains a removed derived container

        Parameters:
        containerName - the shortname of the removed container
        Returns:
        true, if a container with this name was removed.
